html:
Remark. Consequence for the \mu_{\mathrm{arch}} programme: the operator-algebra carrier is in hand; only the CFS identification is conjectural

Consequence for the \mu_{\mathrm{arch}} programme. The operator-algebra realisation of the QOU pre-Archimedean substrate derives from the Jones–Wenzl theorem (Markov-trace GNS embedding). The CFS comparison summary conjectures only the identification of the GNS-image data with causal-fermion-system data (\mathcal{F}, \rho). The exact CFS Lagrangian form remains open.
